final: WITH per_category AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM per_category) SELECT p.category, p.avg_remaining, p.total, p.total - o.avg_total AS above_average FROM per_category p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.total > o.avg_total
